events.description: An arbitrage opportunity was detected across books.
events.trigger: arb_scanner finds a pair of opposing-side odds whose implied probabilities sum < 1.0.

events.description: A +EV pick was identified (sharp book disagrees with soft books).
events.trigger: ev_finder compares pinnacle no-vig fair line vs soft-book line; emits when edge > threshold.

events.description: A tracked line crossed a configured threshold.
events.trigger: Customer-configured threshold breach on a tracked event/market.

events.description: An in-play arbitrage opportunity (faster decay than pre-match arbs).
events.trigger: inplay_scanner finds an arb on a currently-live event.

events.description: A book moved a price significantly from its recent average.
events.trigger: Price drop > 10% from rolling 5-min average on a tracked market.

events.description: A new event was added to the catalogue.
events.trigger: Daily catalogue refresh discovered an event not previously tracked.

events.description: Fired manually via POST /v1/webhooks/{id}/test for integration testing.

signing.verification_pseudocode: hmac_sha256(secret=webhook_secret, message=raw_body) == unhexlify(v1_value). Also verify abs(now - t) < 300 to reject replay attacks beyond a 5-minute window.

retry_policy.on_auto_disable: Email sent to account owner; is_active flips to false; webhook stops receiving deliveries until re-enabled via PATCH /v1/webhooks/{id}.

tier_gate.rationale: Webhooks require background delivery + retry infrastructure; reserved for paying tiers.

filtering.sport_filter: When creating a webhook, set sport_filter=["baseball_mlb","basketball_nba"] to receive only events for those sports. Omit to receive everything.

industry_pattern: Modeled after Stripe/Twilio/GitHub webhook conventions: HMAC-SHA256 signing, timestamped header to prevent replay, automatic retry with exponential backoff, auto-disable on persistent failure. Standard webhook receiver libraries (svix, stripe-event-webhook) work out of the box.
